name: Helper Agent v1.0.0 bounded analogy regression
description: Redacted Helper regression for current Decision relevance, concise progressive explanation, claim-level analogy correction, high-state availability and no forced quiz.

criteria.description: The focused Decision satisfies the strict runtime contract.
criteria.successDefinition: The current Helper Decision context passes validation.

criteria.description: The bounded Helper output contains no credential sentinel or host user path.
criteria.successDefinition: No forbidden sentinel or user-home path remains.

criteria.description: The first answer stays concise and explains the current Decision impacts and recommendation limits.
criteria.successDefinition: A reviewer can connect the answer to the focused Decision without unrelated teaching.

criteria.description: The Helper recognizes the correct row mapping and separately corrects the model-to-column mismatch and analogy limit.
criteria.successDefinition: The compound analogy is neither accepted nor rejected as a whole.

criteria.description: Quick actions change explanation mode without becoming Evidence, and a high Concept State does not hide Helper or force a quiz.
criteria.successDefinition: The response remains available, offers optional depth and contains no mandatory test or repeat-back demand.
